item.title: Crux Beta 1.0
item.description:
# Crux Beta 1.0 (build 3) / Early Preview
## 中文
适用于 Apple Silicon（arm64），要求 macOS 26 或更高版本。
- 首次安装请下载 **Crux-Beta-1.0-arm64.dmg**，通过 Finder 将 **Crux Beta.app** 拖入 Applications 后启动。 - ZIP 包也包含应用，并用于 Sparkle 更新；GitHub 的 Source code 压缩包是源码，不是安装包。 - 已安装且配置更新密钥的同渠道版本可通过应用菜单的 Check for Updates 检查更新。 - SHA256SUMS.txt 提供安装包校验和。Crux 与 Crux Beta 使用独立的数据目录和更新渠道。
本预览版采用 ad-hoc 签名，未经 Apple Developer ID 签名或公证。首次打开可能被 Gatekeeper 阻止；仅在信任此应用时，在系统设置 → 隐私与安全性中选择“仍要打开”。不要关闭系统整体安全检查。
Sparkle 签名用于验证更新包，与 Apple 公证不同。已完成真实验收：Beta build 1 经公开 HTTPS 下载更新至 build 3，安装并自动重启成功；更新后签名完整，文档阅读正常，再次检查显示已是最新版。
## English
For Apple Silicon (arm64), requiring macOS 26 or later.
- For a first installation, download **Crux-Beta-1.0-arm64.dmg** and use Finder to drag **Crux Beta.app** into Applications before launching it. - The ZIP also contains the app and is used for Sparkle updates. GitHub Source code archives are not app installers. - Installed builds on the same channel with an update key can use Check for Updates in the app menu. - SHA256SUMS.txt provides package checksums. Crux and Crux Beta use separate data directories and update channels.
This preview is ad-hoc signed, without Apple Developer ID signing or notarization. Gatekeeper may block the first launch. Only if you trust this app, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Do not disable system-wide security checks.
Sparkle signatures verify updates and are separate from Apple notarization. Real acceptance passed: Beta build 1 downloaded build 3 over public HTTPS, installed it, and relaunched successfully. The updated signature is intact, document reading works, and a subsequent update check reports the latest version.
